page_title: MAR 4-1 MNT | Marseille v Montpellier 25/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+1' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
90+1' Benjamin Lecomte pulls off a great save to deny Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the left side of the goal.
89' Marseille have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
86' Jeremie Pignard shows a yellow card to Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier) for a tough tackle.
84' Jean-Louis Gasset has decided to make a change. Abdoul Bamo Meite (Marseille) replaces Samuel Gigot.

82' 4 - 1 Bad communication between Falaye Sacko (Montpellier) and the goalkeeper led to an own goal. Thumbs down. Well, let's see if he can correct his mistake with a strike into the opponent's goal.
81' Today's match ends for Iliman Ndiaye who will be replaced by Jean Onana (Marseille).
80' A substitution has been made. Jordan Veretout is replaced by Azzedine Ounahi (Marseille).
78' Michel Der Zakarian decides to make a substitution. Arnaud Nordin will be replaced by Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier).
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yann Karamoh (Montpellier) replaces Mousa Al-Tamari.

76' What an opportunity! Samuel Gigot (Marseille) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
75' A yellow card for a tackle by Modibo Sagnan (Montpellier). Jeremie Pignard doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
73' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
71' Here comes a substitution. Teji Savanier is given a rest as he is replaced by Leo Leroy (Montpellier).
70' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Joris Chotard walks off the pitch to be replaced by Khalil Fayad (Montpellier).
70' Michel Der Zakarian has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Akor Adams (Montpellier) replacing Silvan Hefti.
70' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 13:8.
67' Rough tackle by Pape Gueye (Marseille). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
65' Amine Harit (Marseille) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Jeremie Pignard ignores the protests.
64' Jean-Louis Gasset prepares a substitution. Geoffrey Kondogbia is replaced by Pape Gueye (Marseille).
64' Substitution. Quentin Merlin makes his way off the pitch and Ulisses Garcia (Marseille) comes on as his replacement.
62' 3 - 1 Goal! Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Benjamin Lecomte into the bottom right corner.
62' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
61' The Marseille players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
60' There's a break in play and referee Jeremie Pignard must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Marseille using VAR. This could be interesting!
60' PENALTY APPEAL by Marseille, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
57' Amine Harit (Marseille) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

56' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.

56' Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Jeremie Pignard blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
54' The resulting set piece from Marseille is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

52' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot low towards the middle of the net is denied by Pau Lopez. This effort didn't really trouble him.
49' Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) looks up on the edge of the box and rifles in a screamer of a shot that flies just over the bar.
48' Jeremie Pignard shows a yellow card to Silvan Hefti (Montpellier), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Corner kick falls to Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier), who attempts to finish. Luck is not on his side today as the ball crashes against the right post.
45+2' Montpellier force their opponents to concede a corner.
45+1' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Marseille.
45+1' 3 additional min. will be played.
43' 2 - 1 Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
40' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Pau Lopez.
35' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Marseille comes to nothing.
35' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. It will be a corner kick for Marseille.
32' The whistle blows and Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) is booked for an infringement.
32' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) picked up a yellow card from referee.
31' 1 - 1 Goal! Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top of the net. He makes it 1:1.
30' Marseille can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
27' Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.

25' A long cross into the middle of the area is pounced on by Samuel Gigot (Marseille), but his header curls narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.

22' A neat pass finds Quentin Merlin (Marseille) in space. He needs no second invitation to shoot and hits a piledriver from distance towards the middle of the goal, but Benjamin Lecomte denies him with a good save.
20' What a huge chance for Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
15' Modibo Sagnan (Montpellier) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle for a foul.
12' Montpellier failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
12' Montpellier take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
12' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) is angry with himself. The ball breaks to him but he hits the right post!
11' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Montpellier.

11' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The referee signals a corner kick to Montpellier.
8' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
7' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
5' 0 - 1 Goal! Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) is gifted a chance inside the box and makes no mistake putting the ball into the net with a fine header. 0:1.
3' The corner is swung in but Marseille can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
2' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jeremie Pignard has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Marseille will kick the game off.
Jeremie Pignard is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
